in_marathi.name: Axay
in_marathi.long_meaning: Axay हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Axay is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Akshaya’, which means ‘never-decreasing’. This name is considered auspicious and bestowed with divine blessings of prosperity and good fortune. It is believed that the name Axay brings happiness and success to the bearer.
